snippet.title: Ultimate Trial V1.2 Trailer
snippet.description:
🔀 ENEMY RANDOMIZER – How It Works
Three options are available when creating your save file. You can change them later from the menu, but only while inside the Stronghold.
Every time you enter a new room, enemies are shuffled — you'll never face the exact same ones twice!

⚪ Disabled
Enemies are not randomized. You'll face them as in the original game.
🟡 Logic
Enemies are shuffled within their original area. For example, in the Deku Tree, you'll fight enemies that normally appear in that dungeon — just in random spots.
🔴 Nologic
Enemies are shuffled with no logic at all. Expect to fight a Stalfos or a Moblin in the very first room of the Deku Tree!

If you notice any issue or have any feedback or suggestion, feel free to let us know on our Discord Server !

Discord : https://discord.gg/bSxVK8xSHu
Download : https://github.com/RichieUltimate/ultimate-trial
Changelog : https://github.com/RichieUltimate/ultimate-trial/releases/tag/v1.1

Have fun !
